comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/531005985 (Breckenridge), Peaks 6 to 10 on one ticket. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-04 against the resort's 2026-27 winter trail map (breckenridge.com, 20261103_BR_winter-trail_map_001.pdf, rendered at four times its size and read tile by tile: Easiest, More Difficult, Difficult as a single diamond, Most Difficult as two, Extreme Terrain as two with an E; its lift-stats table lists 20 named lifts plus the learning areas' surface lifts, its TERRAIN PARKS box Eldorado, American and Freeway) and its text layer for the spellings; the resort's lift and terrain status page loads its list by script and gives no second source, so the printed map is the only one and wins. OSM's advanced, expert and extreme are the map's single diamond, double diamond and E; 230 of the 234 named runs already carry the map's rating. Four ratings follow the map: Southern Cross (one diamond on the map, expert in OSM), the top 143 m of Duke's Run (a single blue run on the map, black in OSM), the top 389 m of Springmeier (green from its start below Vista Haus; blue in OSM) and the bottom 143 m of Columbia (blue to the base; green in OSM). Parks: the map's three are Eldorado (a snow park in OSM already), Freeway (Peak 8) and American (the middle section of American beside the Beaver Run SuperChair, which the map draws orange and labels American Terrain Park), which get the park flag and the map's names; Park Lane and Gold Run, which the website calls terrain parks, are not in the map's list and stay plain. Lift names from the lift-stats table: Quicksilver SuperChair, Freedom SuperChair, Peak 8 SuperConnect (one lift with a mid-load station, mapped as two ways named Lower and Upper), Eldorado Platter & Carpet. Run names from the map: Pat's Wonderland (OSM wonderland), Sublime (OSM subline), South Col, Lake Chutes, Y-Chute, C.J.'s, C.J.'s Cabin, Quandary (the way's piste:name Quandry is printed first), Powerline, A Chair Line, Barton Breezeway, Forget-Me-Not, Brill's Thrill, Eagle's Nest, Duke's Run on its lower way, and the capitals of the Peak 6, Peak 7 and Horseshoe Bowl chutes OSM has in lower case (Sanctuary to Chi, Vertigo, Magic Carpet, Breathless, King to Lulu). Names that differ from the map only by an apostrophe or a space stay as OSM has them (Toms Baby, Devils Crotch, Needles Eye, Angels Rest, Rounder's), as do the accents of Déjà Vu and lower-case names the map does not print at all (awakening, foresight, liberation and unbound in Beyond Bowl; crazy Ivan 1 and 2, zero chute, dwarves and vertical cornice in the Lake Chutes; cucumber #1 and #2 in Cucumber Bowl). Hidden: nothing; Copper Mountain's lifts and runs in the Overpass window go by the neighbour rule (resorts.json). The runs tagged backcountry in OSM (the Peak 6 and 7 bowls, the Lake Chutes, Horseshoe Bowl, Whiskey River, Windows, The Back 9) lie inside the polygon and stay in bounds, as the map draws them inside the boundary. OSM gaps (shipped as at Palisades Tahoe): North Bowl and Contest Bowl (Peak 7 and 8), Humbug (Horseshoe Bowl), the kids' zones Dragon Trail, Porcupine Alley, Ripperoo's Forest and Lost Cabin; Cucumber Bowl is mapped as its two chutes.

overrides.reason: Southern Cross is a single black diamond (Difficult) on Breckenridge's 2026-27 trail map, below the E-Chair top; OSM rates it expert.

The top 143 m of Duke's Run from beside the Rocky Mountain SuperChair top, rated advanced in OSM; the map draws Duke's Run as one blue (More Difficult) run from the lift top, as OSM rates the rest of it (way/127129647).

A mapper's descriptor: the map prints one run, Duke's Run, from the Rocky Mountain SuperChair top down to Northstar, and this 753 m way continues OSM's Duke's Run (way/127129650); with one name the two draw as one line.

The top 389 m of Springmeier from the 4 O'Clock junction below Vista Haus, rated intermediate in OSM; the map draws Springmeier green (Easiest) from its start, as OSM rates its lower way (way/127129010).
The bottom 143 m of Columbia at the Beaver Run base, rated easy in OSM; the map draws Columbia blue (More Difficult) to the base, as OSM rates its main way (way/128941954).
